professionalSummary.text: Seasoned performance engineer with two years of experience designing load scenarios, analyzing latency bottlenecks, and coordinating test windows for a credit monitoring platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.

experienceHighlights.text: Designed load scenarios for batch and online components, collecting comprehensive resource metrics.
experienceHighlights.witness: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.

experienceHighlights.text: Analyzed latency distributions, identified p95 bottleneck, and documented findings in performance reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.

experienceHighlights.text: Provided structured performance sign‑off inputs for four releases, maintaining release approval with the platform manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Provided the performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated test windows with lending operations to avoid overlap with month‑end processing and documented responsibilities.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the performance test windows with lending operations so that batch runs did not overlap with month-end processing, recording the agreed windows and my responsibility for the test data in the test plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each performance test cycle.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Performance report and sign‑off checklist for a release, including run identifiers and manager approval note.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the performance report for one release (scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks) and the sign-off input checklist with the platform manager's approval note, with the test platform's run identifiers as a verification trail.
